brief: An island-town cottage lot: John Denzel House, a 19th-century Lake Erie house; see the photo for its massing, porch and trim. One photo; year estimated. Older than 1970: the Lake Erie shore towns that stand in for Victory Bay's island streets (Vermilion, Sandusky, Put-in-Bay) were built 1840-1920, and Commons has almost no newer cottages there. Foundations taken deeper than needed (spec rule 4).

facade.notes: the John Denzel House (Vermilion, 1880s), now an inn: a cream two-storey upright and wing; the upright has a two-storey columned porch with a balustraded balcony, the wing a porch with a sign; a black iron fence and gate, lamp posts, a large shade tree in front

why.note: captains' houses in a lake resort town reused as inns
